question.text: 500 mL of 1.2 M KI solution is mixed with 500 mL of $0.2 \mathrm{M} \mathrm{KMnO}_{4}$ solution in basic medium. The liberated iodine was titrated with standard $0.1 \mathrm{M} \mathrm{Na}_{2} \mathrm{~S}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{3}$ solution in the presence of starch indicator till the blue color disappeared. The volume (in L) of $\mathrm{Na}_{2} \mathrm{~S}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{3}$ consumed is $\_\_\_\_$. (Nearest integer)
